description:
A TikTok profile summary plus its newest videos (max 12, from the public embed) with cover, play URL and play count.
Cost: 1 credit per successful call (failed calls are refunded).
Returns: user_id (string, nullable), username (string), nickname (string), signature (string), is_verified (boolean), is_private (boolean), follower_count (integer, nullable), following_count (integer, nullable), heart_count (integer, nullable), avatar_url (string, nullable), posts (array<object>), posts_fetched (integer), has_more (boolean).

limit.description: Maximum number of videos to return. Example: 12

username.description: TikTok username, @handle or profile URL. Example: "khaby.lame"

name: tiktok_posts
title: TikTok videos
